heroic_strike.notes: Locked in as the kit's flat horizontal baseline arc; every other warrior strike now deliberately breaks from this plane.

battle_shout.notes: 2-min rally buff now visibly holds: blood-red war-sigil runes orbit the caster with a pulsing shell lingering 3s after the cry wave.

rend.notes: 9s bleed now lingers 4s — wound keeps flickering and weeping falling blood drips so the DoT reads for its duration.

hamstring.notes: Shifted to blood palette with a low horizontal leg-cut plus weeping bleed drips — splits it from Heroic Strike and sells the crippling maim.

bloodrage.notes: Rage-for-health now orbits crackling blood-red spark orbs for a short 2s linger — the paid-in-blood surge visibly burns on the caster.

overpower.notes: Riposte is now a straight thrust lunge line — reads as a reactive counter-stab, no longer confusable with Heroic Strike's swing.

execute.notes: Death-sentence capstone maxed to 1.6 power: vertical executioner overhead with groundSlam shock ring + cracked earth; splits from Slam by blood palette, power, and finisher sky-strike.

slam.notes: Vertical overhead with groundSlam ground-thud its notes promised, plus a 1.5s windup matching its cast time; grey-steel vs Execute's blood-red keeps the pair distinct.

cleave.notes: Untouched visuals — kept as the flat forward steel sweep; already distinct from Thunder Clap by palette and radius.

defensive_stance.notes: Utility stance toggle: orbit none with a short 2s shell linger — quietly held shield-shell, still the least flashy effect by design.

sunder_armor.notes: Rising uppercut shear that rips armor plates skyward in a spray of sparks — unique arc splits it from the other physical strikes.

fireball.notes: Added drip:rise + linger 3 so the 4s ignite DoT keeps ember flecks rising off the target for its duration - the burn now visibly outlives the impact.

frostbolt.notes: Added linger 2 so rime glitter and the underfoot frost decal hold on the target, reading the 5s 40% slow instead of vanishing on impact.

frost_armor.notes: orbit none + linger 2: the creeping-frost shell now persists briefly but stays hushed, keeping the hierarchy where ice_barrier is the one loud frost buff.

arcane_intellect.notes: orbit sparks + linger 2 - three violet motes with tiny arcs circling the head like firing synapses; unique orbit so no two mage buffs share a look.

conjure_water.notes: Re-shaded frost->arcane to match its arcane school (the authored note already calls for an arcane rune circle) and split it from frost_armor; orbit none + minimum linger keeps it a utility whisper.

polymorph.notes: linger 4 keeps the drifting wool tufts and gentle stars orbiting the sheep so the long CC reads for its duration, not just at apply.

frost_nova.notes: linger 3.5 holds the frozen enemy shells and spreading floor rime through the root - the signature freeze now visibly persists instead of melting in 1-2s.

scorch.notes: burst.style ground - the flame erupts from beneath the target (ignition-from-below) which matches 'ignites directly on the target' and cleanly splits Scorch from Fire Blast's snap link zap; power/scale hierarchy unchanged.

ice_barrier.notes: orbit runes + linger 4 - four glinting ice sigils circle the caster while the interlocking plate shell keeps pulsing, holding the absorb read as a persistent wall of ice.

sinister_strike.notes: Kit's lone horizontal arc: the signature saber sweep, so the spam builder reads instantly apart from every dagger move.

backstab.notes: Sole thrust in the kit — straight lunge line punched into the target's back, cleanly split from sinister_strike's sweep.

gouge.notes: Rising eye-rake uppercut whose upward flick launches the daze stars; arc + stars now fully separate it from same-palette same-power sinister_strike.

eviscerate.notes: Capstone gut-rip: twin rising uppercut slashes with camera kick plus weeping blood drips — shares uppercut with gouge but blood palette/1.45/2 swings/bleed keep it unmistakable.

kidney_shot.notes: Reworked as an icepick-grip vertical stab into the lower back; pairs with ambush on vertical but steel palette + bright stun stars vs shadow keep them apart, and it no longer doubles backstab's thrust.

ambush.notes: Overhead shadow dagger plunge — vertical chop matches the stealth-opener fantasy; shadow palette splits it from kidney_shot's steel vertical.

evasion.notes: Deflection now persists: steel parry-sparks orbit the blur veil for the full 4s linger — blades glancing off an untouchable silhouette.

slice_and_dice.notes: Whirring dagger-glint sigils orbit for the duration so the spun-up-blades haste read holds instead of vanishing after the flash.

sprint.notes: Utility treatment: no orbit and a brief 1.5s linger so the kick-off reads without ever upstaging combat VFX.

adrenaline_rush.notes: Blood-red adrenal sparks crackle around the heartbeat shell for 3.5s — the 3-min moment visibly runs hot; blood palette + raise style split it from evasion's steel-spark veil.

stealth.notes: Kept deliberately quiet: no orbiters (they would betray concealment), short 2s shimmer as the veil settles into translucency.

seal_of_righteousness.notes: Added orbiting golden seal-sigils (runes) + 3s linger so the 30s imbue stays visibly active on the caster; the payoff still belongs to Judgement.

devotion_aura.notes: Shifted to white-silver holy palette with orbit 'none' + short 2s linger — quiet protective toggle, now visually distinct from the gold seal/blessing cluster.

blessing_of_might.notes: Gilded valor-sparks orbit + 2s linger — the ally knighting now holds a martial crackle, splitting it from Seal's rune orbit.

divine_protection.notes: Holy ward-glyphs (runes) orbiting the bubble + 3.5s linger so the 10s absorb reads as a persistent physical barrier of light, not a flash.

righteous_fury.notes: Split hard from the gold buff cluster: flame palette with ember-spark orbit + 2.5s linger — righteous wrath simmering as a live threat aura on the tank toggle.

judgement.notes: burst.style skybeam — the verdict now literally crashes from the heavens as the gilded class-signature column; kept power 1.3 finisher.

exorcism.notes: burst.style ground — purging white-gold light erupts from beneath the wicked, opposite polarity to Judgement's skybeam so the kit's two bursts never read alike.

hammer_of_justice.notes: Added 3s linger so the stun stars orbit the target's head for the full 3s lockdown duration.

consecration.notes: 3.5s linger keeps the searing consecration sigil and rising holy embers burning underfoot — hallowed ground now visibly persists.

raptor_strike.notes: Assigned arc vertical - the raptor-talon chop is the kit's overhead blow, anchoring the strike trio's orientation spread.

mongoose_bite.notes: Assigned arc thrust - snapping riposte now reads as a straight lunging bite, splitting it from raptor_strike's vertical chop despite matching palette/power.

wing_clip.notes: Assigned arc horizontal (low sweeping cut at the legs) + bleed so the crippling wound weeps through a short 2s linger, selling the 10s snare and completing the vertical/thrust/horizontal strike spread.

concussive_shot.notes: Was a near-twin of arcane_shot in flight (38 vs 40, same 0.7 head); slowed to 30 with a fatter 0.9 blunt head so it reads thud-not-dart, plus linger 2 for the dazed wobble during the 4s slow.

serpent_sting.notes: DoT persistence pass: linger 4 so the 15s poison visibly bubbles noxious rising fumes for the full read; drip rise kept - venom fumes climb, they don't pool.

aspect_of_the_hawk.notes: Duration-buff pass: leaves orbit reads as drifting feather motes spiraling off the hawk shell, held for a 3s linger - and it splits this aspect from cheetah's.

aspect_of_the_cheetah.notes: Collided with hawk (both nature raise buffs at similar power); shaded to tawny gold sun-speed with orbit none - identity comes from streaking speed-lines, not orbiters - and a short 2s stance linger.

rapid_fire.notes: Big-cooldown haste now persists: sparks orbit like hot-metal glints whirring around the quiver, shell pulsing for a 3s linger to sell the 15s fire-rate surge.

dismiss_pet.notes: Utility toggle treatment: explicit orbit none with the minimum 1.5s linger - the release-to-the-wild veil settles briefly, stays the quietest effect in the kit.

smite.notes: Skybeam by fantasy: the 2s prayer resolves as a literal golden column of judgement crashing from the sky onto the target, crisp impact stack, warm pulse - Smite alone owns the sky silhouette in this kit.

mind_blast.notes: Pinned to link (a psychic zap, not judgement): single-frame violet lance snaps brow-to-skull, then the detonation stack and distorted shock rings carry the apocalypse - keeps the kit's two bursts from twinning with Smite's skybeam.

shadow_word_pain.notes: Persistence pass on the 18s DoT: linger 4 so inky violet drips keep sinking off the target with a low flicker for the whole read; drip stays fall - viscous and oppressive, never fountaining.

power_word_shield.notes: THE bubble now holds: glassy gold-rimmed shell keeps pulsing for linger 4 with glinting Power-Word sigils orbiting it - instantly distinguishable from Fortitude's plain orbit-less blessing.

power_word_fortitude.notes: Long utility blessing kept deliberately quiet: orbit none with a short linger 2 so the warm shell visibly holds a beat then settles - the humble sibling that makes PW:Shield's runed bubble read as special.

renew.notes: HoT persistence + twin-split: steady trickle of rising golden motes now holds for linger 4 to sell the 15s tick cadence, and power nudged to 0.7 so it no longer mirrors Lesser Heal's instant 0.65 pop.

earth_shock.notes: Set burst.style ground — the impact now erupts from beneath the target (seismic fantasy) and cleanly splits it from frost_shock's instant link zap.

frost_shock.notes: Kept link (it is a zap, and earth_shock owns ground) and added a 2.5s linger so the rimed frost-mist keeps clinging to the target for the 50% slow read.

flame_shock.notes: Real 12s DoT now holds: linger 4 keeps the smoldering flicker and rising embers alive on the target; drip rise confirmed correct for fire.

lightning_shield.notes: Gave it the iconic orbit sparks — three crackling orbs with arcs jumping between them — plus linger 4 so the pulsing shell persists; the buff finally reads as a live lightning shield.

rockbiter_weapon.notes: Duration imbue gets orbit runes (earthen sigils glinting around the caster) + linger 2.5 — persistent but clearly the quiet earthy sibling of lightning_shield's sparks.

ghost_wolf.notes: Utility toggle per the rules: orbit none with a short linger 2 so the ghost-mist breath wisps trail briefly after the morph, keeping it hushed and distinct from the combat buffs.

stormstrike.notes: The kit's lone strike gets arc uppercut — the second swing rises with an upward camera kick to meet the sky-strike column — and groundSlam so the answering shock ring cracks the earth; signature moment, mind-blowing on purpose.

demon_skin.notes: Added slow demonic rune sigils orbiting + 3.5s linger so the 30-min armor buff visibly holds; kept the quiet leathery raise shell so it still reads as skin hardening.

immolate.notes: linger 4 so the rising-ember burn flickers on the victim for the DoT's read — the burning linger is the fantasy; drip 'rise' confirmed correct for fire.

corruption.notes: Reshaded shadow->venom + linger 4 to split it from Curse of Agony (was same archetype/palette/drip/~power) — sick green-black ichor sells the authored 'rotting from within' infection read.

curse_of_agony.notes: linger 4 for the wave-ramping drips + power up 0.8->0.95 so the 24s ramping curse outweighs Corruption; keeps the iconic skeletal violet now that Corruption went venom-green.

life_tap.notes: Explicit orbit 'none' and no linger — instant health-to-mana pop, not a held buff; the short inverted-squeeze shell stays punchy and uncomfortable.

fear.notes: linger 4 so the crawling tendril cage persists writhing around the victim as the authored notes intend — dread holds for the duration instead of flashing once.

shadowburn.notes: burst.style 'skybeam' realizes the authored column-of-shadowflame judgement slam (was defaulting to a flat link zap); linger 2 keeps the charred violet decal smoldering after the execute.

mark_of_the_wild.notes: Added leaf-mote orbit + 3s linger so the 30-min blessing visibly holds; leaves distinguish it from Thorns (sparks) and Barkskin (runes).

moonfire.notes: Skybeam burst — a column of moonlight crashes onto the target (the iconic moonfire read) — and linger 4 keeps lunar embers rising for the 9s DoT.

rejuvenation.notes: Linger 4 so the sparse rising leaf motes persist and sell the 12s HoT; stays the softest, quietest heal vs Regrowth/Healing Touch.

thorns.notes: Sparks orbit reads as prickly green retaliation crackle circling the target, splitting it from the other two nature raise-buffs; linger 3.5 holds the bramble shell.

entangling_roots.notes: Linger 4 keeps the vine tendrils lashed around the legs for the root's visible duration instead of evaporating instantly.

bear_form.notes: Toggle: orbit none + short 2s linger on the post-poof shell; power up to 0.9 for bear mass, splitting it from the now-lighter Wolf Form.

maul.notes: Vertical overhead crush with groundSlam — shock ring + cracked earth sell bear weight; owns the vertical arc in the kit.

cat_form.notes: Split from Bear Form twin: moonlit-silver palette (wolf under the moon, echoing Prowl), quicker leaner poof (shellDur 0.8, power 0.8); toggle gets orbit none + 2s linger.

prowl.notes: Stealth toggle: orbit none (nothing glowing should circle a stalker) with a short 2s linger on the settling mist veil.

rake.notes: Horizontal claw-drag arc + bleed weeping drips, linger 4 to telegraph the 9s bleed; fully split from Claw (uppercut, no bleed).

claw.notes: Rising uppercut claw swipe with the upward camera kick — spammable builder now reads opposite to Rake's flat drag; no linger, stays crisp.

regrowth.notes: Linger 3.5 keeps the trickle of rising petals alive for the 21s HoT tail; brighter/faster bloom plus linger separates it from instant-only Healing Touch.

ferocious_bite.notes: Thrust arc — a straight lunging jaw snap — plus bleed so the wound weeps crimson after the finisher; completes the 4-way arc spread (vertical/horizontal/uppercut/thrust).

barkskin.notes: Rune orbit — four glinting sigils like carvings in bark — plus linger 4 so the 15s defensive shell visibly persists; third distinct orbit among the nature buffs.
